purpose: Add factor-specific validity masks to the immutable Tushare one-minute sentiment-clean snapshot without changing raw rows, the failed original five-factor protocol, or any previously published derived row.

field_contract.canonical_close_path: 09:31-15:00, exactly 240 closes; the 09:30 price is never used
field_contract.activity_path: 09:30 volume and amount remain included in full-session totals; no value is edited or imputed

factor_specific_validity.common: exact grid, positive finite source activity, and a matching positive local raw daily close within 0.2%
factor_specific_validity.late_return_30m: common plus positive finite 14:30 and 15:00 closes
factor_specific_validity.late_amount_share_30m: common plus finite nonnegative amount rows, positive full-session amount, and local daily amount reconciliation within 0.5%
factor_specific_validity.late_vwap_to_day_vwap_30m: late_amount_share_30m requirements plus finite nonnegative volume rows, local daily volume ratio 100 within absolute tolerance 0.005, and positive late-window amount and volume
factor_specific_validity.intraday_realized_volatility: common plus all 240 canonical closes positive and finite
factor_specific_validity.opening_gap_digestion: excluded because the historical minute opening-price semantics are not uniform

output_contract.storage: one immutable exception overlay parquet plus a fingerprint-bound manifest referencing the unchanged joint-cleaned base snapshot

coverage_gates_applied_separately_to_eac.denominator: fingerprint-bound active PIT names in the raw source manifest
